description: This file is a Spring MVC Controller named ConfigurationController, responsible for handling HTTP requests related to configuration management in an admin interface of a web application. It provides endpoints for viewing and updating store configurations such as account settings and email settings, interacting with service layers and rendering views.

classes.name: ConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing store configuration and email settings in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayAccountsConfguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display various account-related store configurations, initializing defaults if configurations are missing.

methods.name: saveConfigurations
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save or update configuration settings submitted through the admin UI.

methods.name: displayEmailSettings
methods.description: Displays current email configuration settings, defaulting to environment properties if none exist.

methods.name: saveEmailSettings
methods.description: Saves or updates email configuration settings submitted from the admin interface.

methods.name: setConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set active menu items for configuration pages.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set active menu items for email configuration pages.
